title: Use the local bus
text:
We booked the tickets with Stefan outside the Real Alcazar. He was very informative with information regarding things to see and said this bus company was the local one. The lady at the bus stop, Maria, was also very helpful and friendly. 
The bus was clean, fairly punctual for Spain and went to most of the tourist stops. The audio guide was good, changing half way through the day to give different information. The only thing was sometimes it seemed out of sync.
author: GlenEverard
